name: zsh-autosuggestions
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.7.1"
  plugin_dir: share/zsh/plugins/zsh-autosuggestions

package:
  name: zsh-autosuggestions
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 0df7affff21cd87ed298e6a3970ed08a1dd66a6efa676454ee5b091ad503badf

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  script: |
    install -d "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}"
    install -m 644 zsh-autosuggestions.zsh zsh-autosuggestions.plugin.zsh \
      "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/"

requirements:
  run:
    - __unix
    - zsh >=4.3.11

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - ${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-autosuggestions.zsh
        - ${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-autosuggestions.plugin.zsh
  - script: |
      zsh -f -c 'source "${PREFIX}/${{ plugin_dir }}/zsh-autosuggestions.zsh"; [[ -n "${ZSH_AUTOSUGGEST_HIGHLIGHT_STYLE}" ]]'

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions
  summary: Fish-like autosuggestions for Zsh
  description: |
    Suggests commands as you type, based on command history and completions.
    Press the right arrow key to accept a suggestion.

    Activate it by adding this to your .zshrc:

      source "${CONDA_PREFIX}/share/zsh/plugins/zsh-autosuggestions/zsh-autosuggestions.zsh"
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ManuelLerchner
